Mizan Pharma Logistics: Q2 SAR 134.00M; Q1 SAR 128.00M; growing, SAR +6.00M (+4.69%). Mizan Healthcare Services: Q2 SAR 168.00M; Q1 SAR 163.00M; growing, SAR +5.00M (+3.07%). Mizan Capital: Q2 SAR 62.00M; Q1 SAR 59.00M; growing, SAR +3.00M (+5.08%). Mizan Pharmacy Retail: Q2 SAR 419.00M; Q1 SAR 419.00M; flat, SAR +0.00M (+0.00%). Consolidation eliminations: Q2 SAR -21.00M; Q1 SAR -21.00M. All BU rows plus eliminations reconcile to the reported group totals. Segments here mean business units; this is a quarter-on-quarter comparison, not year-on-year.

rows.question: What were the key movers of revenue vs budget this half — up and down, ranked by impact?

payload.question: What were the key movers of revenue vs budget this half — up and down, ranked by impact?
payload.answer: H1 2026 group revenue: SAR 4,006.00M actual versus SAR 3,904.00M budget, a SAR +102.00M movement. Business-unit movements ranked by absolute impact: Tamween Pharma Distribution: SAR +74.00M (actual 1,268.00M; budget 1,194.00M). Source commentary: NUPCO surge; margin behind on cost events — remediation underway. Mizan Pharma Manufacturing: SAR +15.00M (actual 748.00M; budget 733.00M). Source commentary: Specialty mix ahead; Line 8 on track Q4. Mizan E-Pharmacy: SAR +14.00M (actual 304.00M; budget 290.00M). Source commentary: Volume ahead; delivery price war compressing margin. Mizan Pharmacy Retail: SAR -8.00M (actual 838.00M; budget 846.00M). Source commentary: Eid footfall soft; clinical counters rolling out. Mizan Pharma Logistics: SAR +6.00M (actual 262.00M; budget 256.00M). Source commentary: Dammam hub commissioned 28-Jun. Mizan Digital Health: SAR +5.00M (actual 176.00M; budget 171.00M). Source commentary: MAU 920k; hiring lag flatters margin. Mizan Healthcare Services: SAR -5.00M (actual 331.00M; budget 336.00M). Source commentary: Cardiology consultant gap persists. Mizan Capital: SAR +3.00M (actual 121.00M; budget 118.00M). Source commentary: MTM gains. Consolidation eliminations contribute SAR -2.00M. The complete BU bridge plus eliminations reconciles to the group movement. Source commentary is qualitative context, not a quantified causal allocation.
